newsitem.title: USA: Snyder Oil buys more Gulf of Mex properties.
newsitem.headline: Snyder Oil buys more Gulf of Mex properties.

text.p: Snyder Oil Corp said on Friday it acquired additional interests in its principal Gulf of Mexico properties for roughly $30 million.
The acquisition primarily involves interests in the Pabst and Busch fields located on Main Pass Blocks 255 and 259 offshore Louisiana, the company said.
In addition, the company said it significantly increased its interest in a number of other offshore blocks it believes have significant exploration potential.
Exploratory drilling on the first of these blocks could begin within 45 days, the company said.
SOCO also said it sold or agreed to sell various non-strategic properties for about $30 million.
These properties include interests in the Austin Chalk Trend and in various fields in New Mexico, Nebraska, Louisiana, Texas and Wyoming, the company said.

The properties being sold, which include interests in about 700 wells, are being disposed of in a number of separate transactions, the company said. Most of the dispositions have closed with the rest expected to close before the end of January, the company said.
